errors.OEM_CONFIG: This source build is missing its private OEM configuration. Ask the app maintainer for a configured build.
errors.SETUP_REQUIRED: Charging control is not configured. Open More > Apps > Voldt > App settings.
errors.SETUP_CONFIRM: Local key saved; charging control still needs verification. Open app settings and sign in.
errors.NOT_PAIRED: Cable not paired yet. Open More > Apps > Voldt > App settings and sign in.
errors.LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE: The cable cannot be reached or verified locally. Check Wi-Fi and close other local cable apps. If its IP or key changed, reconnect through app settings.
errors.CHARGE_UNCONFIRMED: The charging command was sent, but the result was not confirmed. Check the cable before trying again.
errors.USER_PASSWD_WRONG: Voldt did not accept this email address or password.
errors.USER_NOT_EXISTS: Voldt could not find this account. Check the country code and account region.
errors.USER_SESSION_INVALID: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again.
errors.OEM_NETWORK_ERROR: Voldt could not be reached. Check Homey's internet connection and try again.
errors.OEM_DEVICE_KEY_MISSING: Voldt did not return a local key for this cable.
errors.OEM_PRODUCT_SCHEMA_MISSING: The cable's charging functions could not be retrieved.
errors.OEM_PRODUCT_MISSING: Voldt did not return a supported cable definition.
errors.OEM_ACCOUNT_DOMAIN: Voldt returned an unsupported account server.
errors.OEM_SIGNATURE_FAILED: The Voldt response could not be verified. Try again later.
errors.OEM_DECRYPT_FAILED: The Voldt response could not be verified. Try again later.
errors.OEM_HTTP_429: Voldt is limiting requests. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.ILLEGAL_CLIENT_ID: Voldt no longer accepts this app's sign-in method. Check for an app update.
errors.CAPTCHA_REQUIRED: Voldt requires extra verification. Complete it in the official Voldt app, then try again. This app cannot display a captcha.
errors.BUSY: Another sign-in or search is still running. Please wait.
errors.INPUT: Check your email, password, country code, region and local IP address.
errors.NO_CABLE: No verified cable was selected. Search again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CABLE: This cable's charging functions are not supported safely.
errors.NO_LOCAL_CONNECTION: Homey cannot verify the cable locally. Check its Wi-Fi connection and close the official Voldt app temporarily.
errors.ONBOARDING_FAILED: The cable could not be linked. Check your account and Wi-Fi connection, then try again.

pair.title: Connect your Voldt cable
pair.intro: Sign in with your Voldt account. Homey retrieves the local key and charging functions automatically, then controls the cable over your home network.
pair.working: Signing in and verifying local cables…
pair.privacy: Your password is used only to sign in and is not saved. Pairing never starts or stops charging.
pair.empty: No reachable, supported cable was found for this account. Connect the cable to Wi-Fi using the Voldt app first. If needed, enter its IP address under account and network options.
pair.repaired: The local connection is restored. Your existing device and Flows are preserved.
pair.already: This cable is already in Homey. Use app settings to reconnect it.

settings.title: Voldt connection
settings.intro: Reconnect an existing cable without removing its device or Flows. To add a cable, use Devices → Add device → Voldt.
settings.empty: Add a Voldt cable through Devices first.
settings.connected: Local connection configured. No account sign-in is needed for daily use.
settings.pending: This device still needs to be connected.
settings.success: Connected. The current setting was read; charging was not changed.
